sloka: सर्वथा कृतकार्योऽहमेष्यामि सह सीतया ।आनयिष्यामि वा लङ्कां समुत्पाट्य सरावणाम् ॥५-१-४२॥
transliteration: sarvathā kṛtakāryo'hameṣyāmi saha sītayā ।ānayiṣyāmi vā laṅkāṁ samutpāṭya sarāvaṇām ॥5-1-42॥

translations.english: "I will, by all means return successful with Sita or else I will uproot Lanka along with Ravana and bring him here".
